source_search_execution_summary.stop_reason: max_iterations_reached_with_sufficient_coverage: Two iterations completed (8 queries executed). The candidate pool contains: (a) a confirmed Q1 2024 PAHO epidemiological update (29 March 2024, EW 12 data); (b) a Brazilian MoH/SVS bulletin referencing SE4/2024 with ~260k probable cases; (c) a peer-reviewed article with EW 11 2024 figures (1,978,372 suspected cases, 656 deaths); (d) state-level official bulletin portals for Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Paraná; (e) InfoDengue structured database. The 50% duplicate rate in iteration 2 signals search saturation. Additional queries are unlikely to yield new authoritative Q1-specific sources beyond what has already been identified.

iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_coverage_assessment: ADEQUATE FOR COLLECTION WORKFLOW. National-level Q1 2024 coverage: confirmed via PAHO 29 March 2024 update (EW 12 data, Americas-wide with Brazil as dominant contributor), MoH bulletin (SE4/2024 ~260k probable cases), and ScienceDirect article (EW 11: 1,978,372 suspected cases, 656 deaths). Subnational coverage: state-level bulletin portals identified for DF, SP, MG, PR; InfoDengue platform available for all states. Full-year 2024 context available from Agência Brasil and COFEN. Gaps remaining: (1) hospitalization counts not yet confirmed in any snippet — likely in MoH bulletins or DATASUS but not surfaced in snippets; (2) confirmed/probable/suspected national breakdown for the full Q1 window (SE1–SE13) not yet in a single confirmed snippet; (3) municipality-level data not yet surfaced. These gaps are addressable by the collection workflow through direct access to the identified candidate URLs rather than additional search queries.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_trustworthiness_assessment: HIGH for primary candidates. gov.br (MoH/SVS bulletin): highest authority, official Brazilian surveillance system. paho.org (29 March 2024 epidemiological update): confirmed Q1 2024 document from authoritative international body. saude.df.gov.br, saude.sp.gov.br, saude.mg.gov.br, dengue.pr.gov.br: official state health secretariat domains. sciencedirect.com article: peer-reviewed, cites SINAN/official data. info.dengue.mat.br: established academic-government surveillance platform. agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br: official Brazilian government news agency. MEDIUM for journalmbr.com.br (newer journal, lower impact). LOW/EXCLUDED: youtube.com, facebook.com, dengue.com (non-authoritative for numeric data).
